hr.intro: Voliš voćni okus? Aloe Peaches spaja aloe veru i breskvu u napitku koji možeš poslužiti rashlađen.
hr.fit: Za one kojima više odgovara breskva nego okus obične aloe vere.
hr.use: Protresi pakiranje i odmjeri količinu navedenu na deklaraciji. Nakon otvaranja prati uputu za čuvanje u hladnjaku.
question: Je li isti kao Aloe Vera Gel?
Nije isti okus ni sastav. Peaches sadrži breskvu, dok je Gel izbor za one koji žele jednostavniji aloe napitak.
fact: Breskva uz aloe veru
Voćni dio razlikuje Peaches od klasičnog Aloe Vera Gela. Udio sastojaka provjeri na pakiranju za svoje tržište.

en.intro: Prefer a fruity flavour? Aloe Peaches combines aloe vera and peach in a drink you can serve chilled.
en.fit: For people who prefer peach to the taste of plain aloe vera.
en.use: Shake the pack and measure the serving on the label. Follow the refrigeration instructions after opening.
question: Is it the same as Aloe Vera Gel?
The taste and ingredients differ. Peaches contains peach; Gel is an option for those who prefer a simpler aloe drink.
fact: Peach alongside aloe
The fruit component distinguishes Peaches from plain Aloe Vera Gel. Check ingredient proportions on your market’s pack.

hr.intro: Topla šalica s biljem i začinima. Aloe Blossom Herbal Tea donosi drukčiji način da napraviš mali predah tijekom dana.
hr.fit: Za ljubitelje biljnih čajeva koji žele nešto drugo od klasičnog crnog čaja.
hr.use: Prelij vrećicu vrućom vodom i ostavi prema uputi pakiranja. Za hladan čaj najprije pripremi čaj pa ga ohladi.
question: Mogu li ga piti hladnog?
Možeš ga pripremiti kao čaj, ohladiti i poslužiti s ledom. Time ne mijenjaš način pripreme naveden na pakiranju.
fact: Bilje i začini
U mješavini se pojavljuju kamilica, đumbir, narančina kora i cimet. Priprema u vodi daje mirisni biljni napitak.

en.intro: A warm cup of herbs and spices. Aloe Blossom Herbal Tea offers a different way to take a quiet break during your day.
en.fit: For herbal tea drinkers looking for an alternative to black tea.
en.use: Pour hot water over a bag and steep as directed. For iced tea, brew first and then let it cool.
question: Can I drink it cold?
Brew it as directed, allow it to cool and serve over ice. Start with the preparation instructions on the pack.
fact: Herbs and spices
The blend includes chamomile, ginger, orange peel and cinnamon. Brewing in water creates an aromatic herbal drink.

hr.intro: Klasični Forever aloe napitak za one koji žele okus aloe vere bez dodanog voćnog okusa. Jednostavno odmjeri svoju porciju.
hr.fit: Za one koji traže osnovni aloe napitak, a ne gel za kožu.
hr.use: Protresi prije uporabe, odmjeri porciju prema lokalnoj deklaraciji i provjeri koliko dugo otvoreno pakiranje smije stajati u hladnjaku.
question: Je li ovo gel za kožu?
Ne. Ovaj se proizvod pije. Forever Aloe Vera Gelly zaseban je proizvod za nanošenje na kožu.
fact: Unutarnji dio lista
Osnova napitka je gel iz unutarnjeg dijela lista aloe vere. Lokalna deklaracija navodi točan udio i dodatne sastojke.

en.intro: The classic Forever aloe drink for people who prefer aloe vera without an added fruit flavour. Simply measure your serving.
en.fit: For people looking for a plain aloe drink, rather than a skin gel.
en.use: Shake before use, measure the serving on your local label and check how long the opened pack can stay refrigerated.
question: Is this a skin gel?
No. This product is a drink. Forever Aloe Vera Gelly is a separate product applied to the skin.
fact: Inner leaf aloe
The drink is based on gel from the inner aloe leaf. Your local label specifies the proportion and additional ingredients.

hr.intro: Aloe napitak s glukozaminom, kondroitinom i MSM sastojkom u jednoj boci. Freedom se po toj kombinaciji razlikuje od klasičnog Aloe Vera Gela.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje traže aloe napitak s posebno odabranim dodatnim sastojcima.
hr.use: Protresi i odmjeri prema uputi svoje zemlje. Provjeri izvor glukozamina i alergene prije prve uporabe.
question: Po čemu se razlikuje od Aloe Vera Gela?
Freedom uz aloe veru sadrži dodatne sastojke. Nije ista formula u drugom okusu niti zamjena za liječenje tegoba.
fact: Posebna kombinacija
Uz aloe veru, formula navodi glukozamin, kondroitin i MSM. Zato se sastav razlikuje od običnih aloe napitaka.

en.intro: An aloe drink with glucosamine, chondroitin and MSM in one bottle. This combination sets Freedom apart from classic Aloe Vera Gel.
en.fit: For people looking for an aloe drink with a specific combination of added ingredients.
en.use: Shake and measure as directed in your country. Check the glucosamine source and allergens before first use.
question: How does it differ from Aloe Vera Gel?
Freedom includes added ingredients alongside aloe. It is not simply another flavour or a substitute for treatment.
fact: A distinct combination
Alongside aloe, the formula lists glucosamine, chondroitin and MSM. This distinguishes it from plain aloe drinks.

hr.intro: Aloe vera, brusnica i jabuka u jednom napitku. Berry Nectar može biti zanimljiv ako ti više odgovaraju voćni, blago kiselkasti okusi.
hr.fit: Za one koji biraju aloe napitak prema okusu brusnice i jabuke.
hr.use: Protresi prije točenja i slijedi preporučenu porciju. Nakon otvaranja čuvaj prema uputi na pakiranju.
question: Je li ovo sok od brusnice?
To je aloe napitak s voćnim sastojcima. Točan udio aloe, brusnice i jabuke provjeri na lokalnom pakiranju.
fact: Brusnica i jabuka
Voćni sastojci oblikuju okus ovog aloe napitka. Berry Nectar nije isto što i čist sok od brusnice.

en.intro: Aloe vera, cranberry and apple in one drink. Berry Nectar is an option if you enjoy fruity, slightly tart flavours.
en.fit: For people who prefer cranberry and apple flavours in their aloe drink.
en.use: Shake before pouring and follow the recommended serving. Store as directed on the pack after opening.
question: Is this cranberry juice?
It is an aloe drink with fruit ingredients. Check your local pack for the proportions of aloe, cranberry and apple.
fact: Cranberry and apple
Fruit ingredients shape this aloe drink’s flavour. Berry Nectar is not the same as plain cranberry juice.

hr.intro: Aloe vera s tropskim okusom manga. Ako ti obična aloe nije prvi izbor, ovo je voćna varijanta koju vrijedi upoznati.
hr.fit: Za ljubitelje manga koji žele voćnu varijantu Forever aloe napitka.
hr.use: Protresi, posluži prema porciji na deklaraciji i zatvoreno pakiranje spremi kako nalaže uputa.
question: Mogu li zamijeniti Peaches Mangom?
Možeš birati okus koji ti odgovara, ali usporedi sastojke i preporučenu porciju. Različiti okusi nisu potpuno isti proizvod.
fact: Tropski voćni okus
Mango daje prepoznatljiv voćni karakter napitku s aloe verom. Za sastav i zaslađivanje mjerodavna je lokalna deklaracija.

en.intro: Aloe vera with a tropical mango flavour. If plain aloe is not your first choice, explore this fruity alternative.
en.fit: For mango lovers who want a fruity version of a Forever aloe drink.
en.use: Shake, serve the labelled portion and store the closed pack as directed.
question: Can I choose Mango instead of Peaches?
Choose the flavour you prefer, but compare ingredients and serving directions. Different flavours are not identical products.
fact: Tropical fruit flavour
Mango gives an aloe drink its distinctive fruit character. Check your local label for ingredients and sweetening.

hr.intro: Gotov energetski napitak u limenci, bez miješanja praška. FAB Active Boost ima vlastitu formulu i razlikuje se od FAB X varijante.
hr.fit: Za odrasle koji žele gotov napitak i svjesno prate unos kofeina.
hr.use: Posluži rashlađen ako ti tako odgovara. Poštuj ograničenja s deklaracije i uračunaj kofein iz drugih napitaka.
question: Je li isti kao FAB X?
Ne treba ih zamijeniti bez usporedbe. FAB i FAB X mogu imati različit sastav, zaslađivanje i dostupnost po zemljama.
fact: Gotov za posluživanje
Za ovaj napitak nije potreban shaker. Guarana je jedan od izvora kofeina navedenih u opisanoj formuli.

en.intro: A ready to drink energy drink in a can, with no powder to mix. FAB Active Boost has its own formula and differs from FAB X.
en.fit: For adults who want a ready made drink and keep track of caffeine intake.
en.use: Serve chilled if preferred. Follow label limits and account for caffeine from other drinks.
question: Is it the same as FAB X?
Compare them before choosing. FAB and FAB X can differ in ingredients, sweetening and country availability.
fact: Ready to serve
This drink needs no shaker. Guarana is one of the caffeine sources listed in the described formula.

hr.intro: Biljni ekstrakti, kofein i vitamini u obliku tableta. Therm je zaseban dodatak koji se pojavljuje i u pojedinim Forever programima prehrane i kretanja.
hr.fit: Za odrasle koji proučavaju sastav dodataka u programu prehrane i kretanja.
hr.use: Uzmi samo količinu navedenu na lokalnoj deklaraciji. Prije uporabe zbroji kofein iz kave, energetskih napitaka i drugih dodataka.
question: Hoće li sam proizvod smanjiti težinu?
Ne može se obećati takav rezultat. Prehrana, kretanje i osobne okolnosti imaju važnu ulogu; proizvod ne zamjenjuje te navike.
fact: Biljni ekstrakti i vitamini
Formula uključuje biljne izvore kofeina te vitamine. Količine ovise o porciji navedenoj na lokalnom pakiranju.

en.intro: Plant extracts, caffeine and vitamins in tablet form. Therm is a separate supplement also included in some Forever nutrition and activity programmes.
en.fit: For adults comparing supplements within an eating and activity programme.
en.use: Use only the amount on your local label. Account for caffeine from coffee, energy drinks and other supplements.
question: Will the product alone reduce my weight?
That outcome cannot be promised. Food, activity and individual circumstances matter; the product does not replace those habits.
fact: Botanicals and vitamins
The formula includes botanical caffeine sources and vitamins. Amounts depend on the serving on the local pack.

hr.intro: Forever Lean donosi biljnu formulu u kapsulama. Praktičan je za osobe koje traže taj oblik dodatka uz svoj plan prehrane, umjesto napitka ili shakea.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje uspoređuju dodatke prehrani prije uključivanja u svoj plan.
hr.use: Provjeri lokalnu preporučenu količinu i vrijeme uzimanja uz obroke. Ne preuzimaj dozu s drugog proizvoda sličnog naziva.
question: Mogu li preskočiti obroke ako ga koristim?
Ne. Lean nije obrok niti zamjena za raznoliku prehranu. Plan obroka ostaje zaseban dio svakodnevnih navika.
fact: Kapsula umjesto napitka
Lean je zasebno doziran dodatak. Ne sadrži cijeli obrok niti se priprema kao proteinski shake.

en.intro: Forever Lean offers a botanical formula in capsules. It is an option for people who prefer this supplement format alongside their eating plan instead of a drink or shake.
en.fit: For people comparing supplements before adding one to their eating plan.
en.use: Check the local serving and timing around meals. Do not borrow directions from another similarly named product.
question: Can I skip meals when using it?
No. Lean is not a meal or a replacement for a varied diet. Meal planning remains a separate part of your routine.
fact: A capsule rather than a drink
Lean is a separately dosed supplement. It does not supply a meal and is not prepared as a protein shake.

hr.intro: Vlakna u pojedinačnim vrećicama koje se lako umiješaju u napitak. Praktičan format kada želiš jednostavno odmjeriti preporučenu količinu.
hr.fit: Za one kojima više odgovara prašak za miješanje nego gotovi žele.
hr.use: Umiješaj sadržaj prema deklaraciji i popij uz dovoljno tekućine. Ne uzimaj suhi prah bez pripreme.
question: Je li isto što i Fiber Fusion?
Ne. Forever Fiber je prašak za miješanje, a Fiber Fusion ima drukčiji oblik i sastav. Usporedi porciju vlakana na pakiranju.
fact: Porcija za miješanje
Pojedinačno pakiranje olakšava pripremu vlakana u tekućini. Usporedi grame vlakana, a ne samo težinu sadržaja vrećice.

en.intro: Fibre in individual sachets that mix into a drink. A practical format when you want an easy way to measure the recommended serving.
en.fit: For people who prefer a mixing powder to a ready made jelly.
en.use: Mix as directed and take with enough fluid. Do not consume the powder dry without preparing it.
question: Is it the same as Fiber Fusion?
No. Forever Fiber is a mixing powder; Fiber Fusion has a different format and formula. Compare fibre per serving on the pack.
fact: A serving to mix
An individual pack makes mixing fibre into liquid convenient. Compare grams of fibre, not just total sachet weight.

hr.intro: Pločica koju možeš ponijeti na posao, izlet ili trening. FastBreak je praktičan međuobrok kada želiš nešto što ne treba pripremati.
hr.fit: Za one koji žele praktičan međuobrok bez miješanja shakea.
hr.use: Provjeri alergene i nutritivnu tablicu prije otvaranja. Čuvaj pločicu prema uputi, osobito kada je nosiš na toplom.
question: Je li to isto kao proteinski shake?
Nije. Pločica i shake razlikuju se po sastavu, porciji i načinu pripreme. Usporedi ih prema obroku koji planiraš.
fact: Pločica s više sastojaka
Opisana varijanta kombinira kikiriki, karamelu, mliječnu čokoladu i sojine sastojke. Alergene provjeri na točnoj varijanti.

en.intro: A bar to take to work, on a day out or to a workout. FastBreak is a convenient snack when you want something that needs no preparation.
en.fit: For people who want a portable snack without preparing a shake.
en.use: Check allergens and nutrition before opening. Store as directed, particularly when carrying it in warm weather.
question: Is it the same as a protein shake?
No. Bars and shakes differ in ingredients, serving size and preparation. Compare them against the meal or snack you plan.
fact: A bar with several ingredients
The described version combines peanuts, caramel, milk chocolate and soy ingredients. Check allergens on the exact version.

hr.intro: Lite Ultra je prašak za pripremu shakea u različitim okusima. Okus i način pripreme odaberi prema ponudi svoje zemlje.
hr.fit: Za one koji žele shake i žele unaprijed znati što ulazi u pripremljenu porciju.
hr.use: Odmjeri prašak i tekućinu kako piše na pakiranju, zatim izmiješaj. Nutritivne vrijednosti ovise i o tekućini koju dodaš.
question: Je li cijena ista za svaki okus?
Ne mora biti. Uz cijenu na ovoj stranici naveden je točan okus ili pakiranje. Ostale varijante provjeri u Forever trgovini.
fact: Okus i priprema čine razliku
Formula Lite Ultra koristi sojin protein. Dodana tekućina mijenja sastav gotovog shakea i njegove nutritivne vrijednosti.

en.intro: Lite Ultra is a shake powder available in different flavours. Choose the flavour and preparation method offered in your country.
en.fit: For people who want a shake and want to know what goes into the prepared serving.
en.use: Measure powder and liquid as directed, then mix. Nutrition also depends on the liquid you add.
question: Does every flavour have the same price?
Not necessarily. The price here identifies the exact flavour or pack. Check other options in the Forever shop.
fact: Flavour and preparation matter
Lite Ultra uses soy protein. The liquid added changes the composition and nutrition of the prepared shake.

hr.intro: Sensatiable dolazi u obliku tableta za žvakanje. Upoznaj formulu i predloženi način uporabe prije uključivanja u svoj raspored obroka.
hr.fit: Za one koji uspoređuju praktične dodatke bez pripreme napitka.
hr.use: Tablete koristi kako navodi deklaracija i poštuj dnevno ograničenje. One ne zamjenjuju planirane obroke.
question: Mogu li ga koristiti umjesto hrane?
Ne. Proizvod nije obrok. Za svoju prehranu i dalje planiraj uobičajene obroke i dovoljno tekućine.
fact: Oblik koji se žvače
Tablete imaju svoju preporučenu količinu. Praktičan oblik ne znači da su namijenjene neograničenom uzimanju između obroka.

en.intro: Sensatiable comes as chewable tablets. Explore the formula and suggested use before adding it to your meal routine.
en.fit: For people comparing convenient supplements that do not require a drink to be mixed.
en.use: Use the tablets as labelled and respect the daily limit. They do not replace planned meals.
question: Can I use it instead of food?
No. It is not a meal. Continue to plan regular meals and adequate fluid intake.
fact: A chewable format
The tablets have a specified serving. Their convenient format does not mean unrestricted use between meals.

hr.intro: Protein graška i bundeve u prašku za pripremu napitka. Plant Protein je izbor za one koji žele biljni izvor proteina u praktičnom obliku.
hr.fit: Za one kojima je biljni izvor proteina važan pri odabiru shakea.
hr.use: Pomiješaj porciju s količinom tekućine navedenom na pakiranju. Ako dodaješ voće ili drugi napitak, mijenja se nutritivni sastav porcije.
question: Je li isto što i Lite Ultra?
Ne. Izvor proteina i cijela formula razlikuju se. Usporedi sastojke, alergene i način pripreme prije odabira.
fact: Grašak i bundeva
Ova formula koristi biljne izvore proteina. Po tome se razlikuje od shakeova koji se oslanjaju na mliječne proteine.

en.intro: Pea and pumpkin protein in a drink powder. Plant Protein is an option for people who want a convenient plant protein source.
en.fit: For people who prioritise a plant protein source when choosing a shake.
en.use: Mix a serving with the labelled amount of liquid. Adding fruit or another drink changes the nutrition of the prepared serving.
question: Is it the same as Lite Ultra?
No. The protein source and full formula differ. Compare ingredients, allergens and preparation before choosing.
fact: Pea and pumpkin
This formula uses plant protein sources, distinguishing it from shakes based on milk proteins.

hr.intro: Devet dana s rasporedom i proizvodima u jednom paketu. Upoznaj što C9 uključuje i koliko pripreme traži prije nego odabereš početak.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje žele pratiti strukturirani početak prehrambenih navika.
hr.use: Prvo pročitaj cijeli vodič, provjeri sadržaj odabrane varijante i pripremi namirnice za obroke predviđene programom.
question: Trebam li kupovati još namirnica?
Da, paket proizvoda nije popis svih tvojih obroka. Prije početka prođi vodič i pripremi namirnice koje program predviđa.
fact: Devet dana s vodičem
Raspored programa i upute prate odabranu varijantu paketa. Proizvodi nisu zamjena za čitanje cijelog vodiča.

en.intro: Nine days with a schedule and products in one pack. Explore what C9 includes and the preparation involved before choosing a start date.
en.fit: For people who want a structured start to their eating habits.
en.use: Read the full guide first, check your chosen pack and prepare the ingredients for meals in the programme.
question: Do I need to buy groceries as well?
Yes. The product pack does not supply every meal. Read the guide and prepare the groceries required before starting.
fact: Nine days with a guide
The schedule and directions accompany the chosen pack. The products do not replace reading the complete guide.

hr.intro: DX4 je četverodnevni program s vlastitim rasporedom. Pogledaj sadržaj paketa i organizaciju dana kako bi znao/la što te očekuje.
hr.fit: Za one koji žele unaprijed planirati četiri dana prehrane i rutine.
hr.use: Pročitaj vodič prije početka. Uskladi kupnju namirnica, vrijeme obroka i uporabu svakog proizvoda s točnom uputom.
question: Je li DX4 kraća verzija C9?
Ne. Programi imaju različito trajanje, proizvode i raspored. DX4 treba pratiti po njegovu vodiču, a ne po uputi za C9.
fact: Četiri dana, vlastiti raspored
DX4 ima zasebne proizvode i vodič. Njegov raspored nije skraćena preslika programa C9.

en.intro: DX4 is a four day programme with its own schedule. Explore the pack and daily routine so you know what to expect.
en.fit: For people who want to plan four days of meals and routine in advance.
en.use: Read the guide before starting. Plan groceries, meal times and each product according to the exact directions.
question: Is DX4 a shorter C9?
No. The duration, products and schedule differ. Follow the DX4 guide rather than adapting C9 directions.
fact: Four days, its own schedule
DX4 has its own products and guide. Its schedule is not simply a shortened version of C9.

hr.intro: F15 povezuje raspored prehrane i kretanja kroz petnaest dana. Usporedi ponuđene varijante i odaberi onu čije upute možeš pratiti.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje žele dulji raspored i jasnije planiranje svakodnevnih navika.
hr.use: Pregledaj vodič i razinu programa. Pripremi obroke i prilagodi aktivnosti svojim mogućnostima prije početka.
question: Moram li prije njega proći C9?
Provjeri preporučeni redoslijed u lokalnom vodiču. Nemoj pretpostaviti da svi paketi i razine imaju iste uvjete početka.
fact: Raspored prehrane i aktivnosti
F15 uključuje smjernice uz proizvode iz odabrane varijante. Provjeri razinu i sadržaj prije početka.

en.intro: F15 connects food and activity planning over fifteen days. Compare the available versions and choose one whose guidance you can follow.
en.fit: For people who want a longer schedule and more structure around daily habits.
en.use: Review the guide and programme level. Prepare meals and adapt activities to your capabilities before starting.
question: Must I complete C9 first?
Check the recommended sequence in your local guide. Do not assume every pack and level has the same starting requirements.
fact: Food and activity planning
F15 includes guidance alongside the selected products. Check the level and contents before starting.

hr.intro: Vitamin D u zasebnom dodatku prehrani. Absorbent D omogućuje da taj nutrijent odabereš odvojeno od široke multivitaminske formule.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje traže zaseban vitamin D umjesto multivitaminske formule.
hr.use: Slijedi lokalnu preporučenu količinu i zbroji vitamin D iz drugih dodataka. Individualnu potrebu provjeri sa stručnom osobom.
question: Mogu li ga dodati svom multivitaminu?
Prvo usporedi ukupnu količinu vitamina D. Više proizvoda može sadržavati isti vitamin pa kombinacija nije automatski potrebna.
fact: Vitamin D u zasebnom proizvodu
Deklarirana formula sadrži vitamin D3. Za usporedbu s drugim dodacima pogledaj količinu po preporučenoj dnevnoj porciji.

en.intro: Vitamin D as a dedicated food supplement. Absorbent D lets you choose this nutrient separately from a broad multivitamin formula.
en.fit: For people looking for vitamin D separately rather than in a multivitamin.
en.use: Follow the local serving and account for vitamin D in other supplements. Discuss individual needs with a qualified professional.
question: Can I add it to my multivitamin?
Compare the total vitamin D amount first. Several products may contain the same vitamin, so combining them is not automatically necessary.
fact: Vitamin D in a separate product
The declared formula contains vitamin D3. Compare the amount per recommended daily serving with other supplements.

hr.intro: Ovisno o tržištu, proizvod ćeš pronaći pod nazivom Forever Move ili ESM Complex. Provjeri lokalnu formulu i pakiranje prije narudžbe.
hr.fit: Za one koji uspoređuju formule s membranom ljuske jajeta i dodatnim sastojcima.
hr.use: Pročitaj sastav, alergene i dnevnu količinu na svojem pakiranju. Naziv s drugog tržišta nije dovoljna potvrda iste upute.
question: Zašto trgovina pokazuje drugi naziv?
Nazivi i varijante ovise o zemlji. Uz cijenu je naveden lokalni proizvod. Ako se sastav razlikuje, ravnaj se prema tom pakiranju.
fact: Membrana ljuske jajeta
Membrana ljuske jajeta jedan je od istaknutih sastojaka. Naziv, dodatni sastojci i uputa mogu se razlikovati po tržištima.

en.intro: Depending on the market, you may find Forever Move or ESM Complex. Check the local formula and pack before ordering.
en.fit: For people comparing formulas containing eggshell membrane and additional ingredients.
en.use: Read ingredients, allergens and serving directions on your pack. A name from another market does not confirm identical directions.
question: Why does the shop show another name?
Names and variants depend on the country. The price identifies the local product. Follow that pack if ingredients differ.
fact: Eggshell membrane
Eggshell membrane is a highlighted ingredient. Names, additional ingredients and directions can differ between markets.

hr.intro: Propolis u praktičnom obliku tableta. Forever Bee Propolis razlikuje se od meda, peludi i matične mliječi, iako svi dolaze iz pčelinjeg svijeta.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje žele propolis u tabletama i dobro podnose pčelinje sastojke.
hr.use: Koristi prema lokalnoj deklaraciji. Prije prve uporabe posebno provjeri pčelinje sastojke ako si na njih osjetljiv/a.
question: Je li ovo med u tabletama?
Ne. Propolis je drukčiji pčelinji materijal. Med, pelud, propolis i matična mliječ imaju različit sastav i način uporabe.
fact: Propolis, a ne pelud
Propolis je zasebna pčelinja sirovina. Tablete imaju drukčiji sastav od proizvoda s peludi ili matičnom mliječi.

en.intro: Propolis in a convenient tablet format. Forever Bee Propolis differs from honey, pollen and royal jelly, though all relate to bees.
en.fit: For people who want propolis tablets and can tolerate bee ingredients.
en.use: Use according to the local label. Check bee ingredients particularly carefully if you are sensitive to them.
question: Is this honey in tablet form?
No. Propolis is a different bee material. Honey, pollen, propolis and royal jelly have different compositions and uses.
fact: Propolis rather than pollen
Propolis is a distinct bee material. Its tablets differ in composition from pollen or royal jelly products.

hr.intro: Vitamini i minerali u obliku gumenih pastila koje se žvaču. Immune Gummy nudi drukčiji format od klasičnih kapsula i tableta.
hr.fit: Za one kojima više odgovara gumeni oblik nego gutanje tablete.
hr.use: Odmjeri dnevnu količinu iz upute. Čuvaj izvan dohvata djece i ne koristi kao bombone za slobodno grickanje.
question: Zašto odabrati gumeni oblik?
Može odgovarati osobama kojima je žvakanje praktičnije od gutanja tablete. Dobna preporuka i dnevna porcija i dalje su važne, jer je riječ o dodatku prehrani.
fact: Vitamini i minerali za žvakanje
Gumeni oblik sadrži više hranjivih tvari u određenoj porciji. Točne vitamine, minerale i zaslađivanje navodi deklaracija.

en.intro: Vitamins and minerals in chewable gummy form. Immune Gummy offers a different format from conventional capsules and tablets.
en.fit: For people who prefer a gummy format to swallowing tablets.
en.use: Measure the daily amount in the directions. Keep out of children’s reach and do not treat the gummies as unrestricted sweets.
question: Why choose a gummy format?
It may suit people who find chewing more convenient than swallowing a tablet. The recommended age and daily serving still matter because it is a food supplement.
fact: Chewable vitamins and minerals
The gummy format provides several nutrients in a defined serving. The label lists exact vitamins, minerals and sweetening.

hr.intro: Vitamin C u tableti za žvakanje. Absorbent C je dodatak prehrani, za razliku od Forever Vitamin C mlijeka koje se nanosi na lice.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje žele vitamin C u obliku koji ne treba progutati cijeli.
hr.use: Sažvači tabletu prema uputi pakiranja i pridržavaj se preporučene dnevne količine. Provjeri ostale sastojke i alergene.
question: Je li ovo onaj Vitamin C za lice?
Ne. Absorbent C uzima se oralno. Forever Vitamin C zaseban je kozmetički proizvod za vanjsku uporabu.
fact: Vitamin C uz dodatne sastojke
Opisana formula povezuje vitamin C, med i zobene mekinje u tableti za žvakanje. Provjeri alergene na svojem pakiranju.

en.intro: Vitamin C in a chewable tablet. Absorbent C is a food supplement, unlike the Forever Vitamin C facial milk applied to skin.
en.fit: For people who want vitamin C in a form that is not swallowed whole.
en.use: Chew as directed on the pack and follow the recommended daily amount. Check the other ingredients and allergens.
question: Is this the Vitamin C product for the face?
No. Absorbent C is taken orally. Forever Vitamin C is a separate cosmetic for external use.
fact: Vitamin C with additional ingredients
The described formula combines vitamin C, honey and oat bran in a chewable tablet. Check your pack for allergens.

hr.intro: Češnjak i timijan zajedno u kapsuli. Garlic Thyme okuplja poznate biljne sastojke u obliku koji ne treba pripremati kao čaj ili napitak.
hr.fit: Za odrasle koji traže dodatak s češnjakom i timijanom.
hr.use: Uzmi prema deklaraciji. Ako uzimaš lijekove, prije dodavanja koncentriranih biljnih sastojaka provjeri odgovara li ti formula.
question: Zamjenjuje li češnjak u prehrani?
Ne. Kapsula je dodatak prehrani, a ne zamjena za raznoliku hranu ili sastojke koje koristiš u kuhanju.
fact: Dvije biljke u formuli
Češnjak i timijan navedeni su kao ključni biljni sastojci. Kapsula pruža odmjerenu porciju prema deklaraciji.

en.intro: Garlic and thyme together in a capsule. Garlic Thyme combines familiar botanical ingredients in a format that needs no brewing or mixing.
en.fit: For adults looking for a supplement containing garlic and thyme.
en.use: Take as labelled. If you use medication, check suitability before adding concentrated botanical ingredients.
question: Does it replace garlic in food?
No. A capsule is a food supplement, not a replacement for varied foods or the ingredients you cook with.
fact: Two botanicals in the formula
Garlic and thyme are listed as the key botanicals. The capsule provides a measured serving according to the label.

hr.intro: Fields of Greens okuplja biljne sastojke u tabletama. Upoznaj što je u formuli i razlikuj dodatak prehrani od povrća na tanjuru.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje žele preglednu biljnu formulu u formatu tablete.
hr.use: Slijedi dnevnu količinu navedenu na lokalnoj deklaraciji. Zadrži povrće i drugu raznoliku hranu u svojoj prehrani.
question: Mogu li njime zamijeniti povrće?
Ne. Tablete ne zamjenjuju porciju povrća, vlakna i raznolikost obroka. Koristi ih samo prema deklariranoj namjeni.
fact: Biljna mješavina
U formuli je više zelenih biljnih sastojaka. Tableta nije nutritivno jednaka porciji svježeg povrća.

en.intro: Fields of Greens brings botanical ingredients together in tablets. Explore the formula and distinguish a supplement from vegetables on your plate.
en.fit: For people who want a botanical formula in tablet form.
en.use: Follow the daily amount on your local label. Keep vegetables and other varied foods in your diet.
question: Can it replace vegetables?
No. Tablets do not replace a serving of vegetables, fibre or dietary variety. Use only as labelled.
fact: A botanical blend
The formula brings together several green botanicals. A tablet is not nutritionally equivalent to a portion of fresh vegetables.

hr.intro: ImmuBlend spaja više sastojaka u jednoj formuli. Usporedi vitamine, minerale i ekstrakte na deklaraciji s dodacima koje već koristiš.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje traže kombiniranu formulu umjesto više zasebnih dodataka.
hr.use: Prvo provjeri preklapaju li se sastojci s postojećim dodacima, zatim slijedi preporučenu uporabu na pakiranju.
question: Po čemu se razlikuje od zasebnog vitamina?
ImmuBlend povezuje više sastojaka u jednoj formuli. Zaseban vitamin pruža uži izbor, pa prije kombiniranja usporedi sastav i preporučene količine.
fact: Više sastojaka zajedno
ImmuBlend kombinira nutrijente i ekstrakte. Cijeli popis pročitaj prije odabira umjesto oslanjanja samo na naziv.

en.intro: ImmuBlend combines several ingredients in one formula. Compare its vitamins, minerals and extracts with supplements you already use.
en.fit: For people considering a combination formula instead of several separate supplements.
en.use: Check for overlapping ingredients with existing supplements, then follow the directions on the pack.
question: How does it differ from a single vitamin?
ImmuBlend combines several ingredients in one formula. A single vitamin offers a narrower choice, so compare ingredients and recommended amounts before combining them.
fact: Several ingredients together
ImmuBlend combines nutrients and extracts. Read the full list rather than relying only on the product name.

hr.intro: Arctic Sea je dodatak s omega 3 masnim kiselinama iz morskih izvora. Pri odabiru pogledaj izvore ulja i količine EPA i DHA na deklaraciji.
hr.fit: Za one kojima odgovara morski izvor omega 3 i kapsule.
hr.use: Uzmi kapsule prema lokalnoj uputi. Provjeri alergene i ukupnu dnevnu porciju, ne samo količinu ulja u jednoj kapsuli.
question: Kako se razlikuje od Algal Omega?
Arctic Sea koristi morske životinjske izvore, a Algal Omega ulje algi. Izvor i količine masnih kiselina usporedi na deklaracijama.
fact: Morski izvori ulja
Opisana formula uključuje ulja ribe i lignje. Izvori i udjeli masnih kiselina nalaze se na lokalnoj deklaraciji.

en.intro: Arctic Sea provides omega 3 fatty acids from marine sources. Check the oil sources and labelled EPA and DHA amounts when comparing products.
en.fit: For people who prefer a marine omega 3 source in capsules.
en.use: Take capsules as locally directed. Check allergens and the total daily serving, not just the oil amount in one capsule.
question: How does it differ from Algal Omega?
Arctic Sea uses marine animal sources; Algal Omega uses algal oil. Compare sources and fatty acid amounts on the labels.
fact: Marine oil sources
The described formula includes fish and squid oils. Sources and fatty acid proportions are listed on the local label.

hr.intro: Odabrane bakterijske kulture u praktičnoj kapsuli. Active Pro B možeš upoznati zasebno ili usporediti s Fiberom, koji donosi vlakna.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje traže kapsule s bakterijskim kulturama umjesto dodatka vlakana.
hr.use: Prati uputu za uzimanje i čuvanje na svom pakiranju. Nemoj pretpostaviti da svi probiotički proizvodi imaju iste uvjete čuvanja.
question: Je li isto što i Forever Fiber?
Ne. Active Pro B sadrži bakterijske kulture, dok Fiber daje prehrambena vlakna. To su različite vrste proizvoda.
fact: Odabrane bakterijske kulture
Formula uključuje kulture iz skupina Lactobacillus i Bifidobacterium. Točne nazive i količine pročitaj na pakiranju.

en.intro: Selected bacterial cultures in a convenient capsule. Explore Active Pro B on its own or compare it with Fiber, which provides fibre.
en.fit: For people looking for bacterial culture capsules rather than a fibre supplement.
en.use: Follow the taking and storage instructions on your pack. Do not assume all probiotic products have identical storage requirements.
question: Is it the same as Forever Fiber?
No. Active Pro B contains bacterial cultures, while Fiber provides dietary fibre. They are different types of product.
fact: Selected bacterial cultures
The formula includes cultures from the Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium groups. Read exact names and amounts on the pack.

hr.intro: Hijaluronska kiselina u obliku dodatka prehrani. Active HA dolazi u kapsulama i ima drukčiju namjenu od hijaluronskog seruma za lice.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje uspoređuju oralne dodatke s hijaluronskom kiselinom.
hr.use: Kapsule koristi samo prema lokalnoj deklaraciji. Provjeri ostale sastojke formule prije kombiniranja s drugim dodacima.
question: Zašto kapsule umjesto seruma?
To su dvije različite vrste proizvoda. Active HA je dodatak prehrani koji se uzima prema uputi, dok serum njeguje kožu izvana. Biraj prema namjeni, a ne samo prema zajedničkom sastojku.
fact: Oralna formula
Hijaluronska kiselina dio je dodatka koji se uzima prema deklaraciji. To nije kozmetički serum koji se razmazuje po koži.

en.intro: Hyaluronic acid in food supplement form. Active HA comes in capsules and has a different purpose from a hyaluronic face serum.
en.fit: For people comparing oral supplements containing hyaluronic acid.
en.use: Use capsules only as locally labelled. Check the remaining formula ingredients before combining with other supplements.
question: Why capsules instead of a serum?
These are two different product types. Active HA is a supplement taken as directed, while a serum cares for skin externally. Choose by purpose rather than the shared ingredient alone.
fact: An oral formula
Hyaluronic acid is part of a supplement used as labelled. This is not a cosmetic serum spread over skin.

hr.intro: ARGI+ kombinira L arginin i vitamine u prašku za napitak. Praktično pakiranje olakšava pripremu prema preporučenoj porciji.
hr.fit: Za odrasle koji žele usporediti napitak s argininom, a ne proteinski shake.
hr.use: Odmjeri i pomiješaj s količinom vode navedenom na pakiranju. Prije kombiniranja s drugim dodacima usporedi ukupne količine vitamina.
question: Je li ARGI+ proteinski shake?
Ne. Aminokiselina L arginin nije isto što i cjeloviti proteinski napitak. Ako tražiš proteinski shake, usporedi Plant Protein ili Lite Ultra.
fact: L arginin i vitamini
Prašak kombinira aminokiselinu L arginin s vitaminima. Sastav porcije razlikuje se od proteinskog shakea.

en.intro: ARGI+ combines L arginine and vitamins in a drink powder. Its format makes it straightforward to prepare the recommended serving.
en.fit: For adults comparing an arginine drink rather than a protein shake.
en.use: Measure and mix with the labelled amount of water. Compare total vitamin amounts before combining with other supplements.
question: Is ARGI+ a protein shake?
No. The amino acid L arginine is not the same as a complete protein drink. For a protein shake, compare Plant Protein or Lite Ultra.
fact: L arginine and vitamins
The powder combines the amino acid L arginine with vitamins. Its serving differs from a protein shake.

hr.intro: Vitamin B12 i folat u jednoj formuli. B12 Plus je usmjeren izbor kada želiš te nutrijente umjesto šire kombinacije vitamina i minerala.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje traže ciljanu kombinaciju B12 i folata.
hr.use: Provjeri deklariranu dnevnu količinu i sastav postojećih dodataka. Ako sumnjaš na manjak vitamina, zatraži stručnu procjenu.
question: Zašto B12 zajedno s folatom?
Oba su sastojka dio ove formule. Ako tražiš baš tu kombinaciju, provjeri količine po preporučenoj porciji i usporedi ih s drugim dodacima koje koristiš.
fact: Dva povezana nutrijenta
B12 i folat objedinjeni su u jednoj formuli. Za usporedbu koristi deklarirane količine, a ne samo veličinu tablete.

en.intro: Vitamin B12 and folate in one formula. B12 Plus is a focused option when you want these nutrients rather than a broader vitamin and mineral combination.
en.fit: For people looking for a focused combination of B12 and folate.
en.use: Check the daily amount and your existing supplements. If you suspect a vitamin deficiency, seek a qualified assessment.
question: Why B12 together with folate?
Both are included in this formula. If you are looking for that combination, check the amounts per recommended serving and compare them with other supplements you use.
fact: Two nutrients together
B12 and folate appear in one formula. Compare labelled amounts rather than tablet size alone.

hr.intro: Pčelinji pelud u tableti za jednostavno doziranje. Bee Pollen je drukčiji proizvod od propolisa i meda, s vlastitim sastavom i uputom.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje traže pčelinji pelud i nisu osjetljive na njega.
hr.use: Slijedi uputu pakiranja i posebno provjeri upozorenja za alergiju na pelud i pčelinje proizvode.
question: Kako odabrati između peludi i propolisa?
Odabir počinje sastavom koji tražiš. Pelud i propolis nisu zamjenjivi nazivi za isti proizvod; usporedi njihovu deklaraciju.
fact: Pelud u odmjerenom obliku
Tablete omogućuju uporabu pčelinjeg peluda prema navedenoj porciji. Važna je provjera sastojaka kod osjetljivosti na pelud.

en.intro: Bee pollen in a tablet for measured use. Bee Pollen differs from propolis and honey, with its own ingredients and directions.
en.fit: For people looking for bee pollen who are not sensitive to it.
en.use: Follow the pack directions and check warnings about pollen and bee product allergies carefully.
question: How do I choose between pollen and propolis?
Start with the ingredient you want. Pollen and propolis are not interchangeable names for one product; compare their labels.
fact: Pollen in a measured format
Tablets provide bee pollen in a stated serving. Ingredient checks matter particularly for pollen sensitivity.

hr.intro: Med za čaj, doručak ili pripremu hrane. Forever Bee Honey jednostavan je izbor kada želiš pčelinji proizvod koji se koristi u kuhinji.
hr.fit: Za ljubitelje meda koji žele zasladiti hranu ili napitak.
hr.use: Dodaj količinu koja odgovara tvojem obroku. Pakiranje drži zatvoreno i čuvaj kako je navedeno na etiketi.
question: Znači li kristalizacija da med nije dobar?
Med može prirodno kristalizirati. Za čuvanje i postupanje s konkretnim pakiranjem prati uputu proizvođača.
fact: Med za kuhinju
Med možeš dodati čaju, jogurtu ili receptu. Računaj ga kao dio hrane koju jedeš, uključujući sadržaj šećera.

en.intro: Honey for tea, breakfast or cooking. Forever Bee Honey is a straightforward option when you want a bee product for the kitchen.
en.fit: For honey lovers who want to sweeten food or a drink.
en.use: Add an amount suited to your meal. Keep the pack closed and store as labelled.
question: Does crystallisation mean honey has gone bad?
Honey can crystallise naturally. Follow the manufacturer’s instructions for storing and handling your particular pack.
fact: Honey for the kitchen
Add honey to tea, yoghurt or a recipe. Count it as part of your food intake, including its sugar content.

hr.intro: Forever Calcium kombinira kalcij s drugim hranjivim tvarima. Prije odabira pogledaj količinu po dnevnoj porciji i izvore kalcija u svojoj prehrani.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje žele usporediti dodatak kalcija s postojećom prehranom.
hr.use: Prati lokalnu preporučenu količinu. Ako koristiš lijekove, provjeri s ljekarnikom treba li razmak između uzimanja.
question: Je li isto što i Nature Min?
Ne. Calcium je usmjeren na kalcij, dok Nature Min ima širu mineralnu formulu. Usporedi pojedine količine, a ne samo broj tableta.
fact: Kalcij s drugim nutrijentima
Formula uz kalcij uključuje i dodatne vitamine ili minerale. Lokalna deklaracija pokazuje točnu kombinaciju.

en.intro: Forever Calcium combines calcium with other nutrients. Check the daily serving and the calcium sources already in your diet before choosing.
en.fit: For people comparing a calcium supplement with their existing dietary intake.
en.use: Follow the locally recommended amount. If you take medicines, ask a pharmacist whether doses need to be spaced apart.
question: Is it the same as Nature Min?
No. Calcium focuses on calcium, while Nature Min has a broader mineral formula. Compare individual amounts, not just tablet counts.
fact: Calcium with other nutrients
The formula includes additional vitamins or minerals alongside calcium. Your local label shows the exact combination.

hr.intro: Nutra Q10 donosi koenzim Q10 u kombiniranoj formuli. Pogledaj ostale sastojke i način pripreme na pakiranju svoje zemlje.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje ciljano uspoređuju dodatke s koenzimom Q10.
hr.use: Pripremi i koristi točno prema lokalnoj deklaraciji. Prije kombiniranja usporedi vitamine koji se ponavljaju u drugim dodacima.
question: Je li Q10 isto što i multivitamin?
Ne. Q10 je određeni sastojak. Ova formula može sadržavati i druge nutrijente, ali nije automatska zamjena za svaki multivitamin.
fact: Koenzim u kombiniranoj formuli
Q10 nije jedini sastojak. U opisu su navedeni i vitamini te minerali koje vrijedi usporediti s ostalim dodacima.

en.intro: Nutra Q10 provides coenzyme Q10 in a combination formula. Explore the additional ingredients and preparation on your country’s pack.
en.fit: For people specifically comparing coenzyme Q10 supplements.
en.use: Prepare and use exactly as locally labelled. Compare overlapping vitamins before combining it with other supplements.
question: Is Q10 the same as a multivitamin?
No. Q10 is a specific ingredient. This formula may also contain other nutrients, but it is not automatically a replacement for any multivitamin.
fact: Coenzyme in a combination formula
Q10 is not the only ingredient. The description also lists vitamins and minerals worth comparing with other supplements.

hr.intro: Više vitamina i minerala u jednom proizvodu. Daily pojednostavljuje izbor ako tražiš široku formulu umjesto niza zasebnih dodataka.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje traže preglednu kombinaciju više vitamina i minerala.
hr.use: Uzmi dnevnu porciju s lokalne deklaracije. Spremi popis drugih dodataka koje koristiš kako bi lakše usporedio/la sastav.
question: Mogu li uz Daily uzimati zasebne vitamine?
Možda ti nisu potrebni. Prvo zbroji ponovljene vitamine i minerale iz svih proizvoda te po potrebi zatraži stručni savjet.
fact: Vitamini i minerali zajedno
Formula obuhvaća više vitamina i minerala. Dnevna porcija određuje se prema pakiranju, ne prema nazivu Daily.

en.intro: Several vitamins and minerals in one product. Daily simplifies the choice when you want a broad formula rather than a collection of separate supplements.
en.fit: For people looking for a combination of several vitamins and minerals.
en.use: Take the daily serving on the local label. Keep a list of your other supplements to make comparison easier.
question: Can I take separate vitamins with Daily?
They may not be necessary. Add up overlapping nutrients across products and seek qualified advice when needed.
fact: Vitamins and minerals together
The formula covers several vitamins and minerals. The pack determines the daily serving, not the name Daily.

hr.intro: iVision okuplja lutein i druge odabrane sastojke u jednoj formuli. Ovdje možeš upoznati što ga razlikuje od uobičajenog multivitamina.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje uspoređuju formule s luteinom i srodnim sastojcima.
hr.use: Slijedi dnevnu porciju na pakiranju. Redovite preglede vida zadrži kao zaseban dio brige o sebi.
question: Po čemu se razlikuje od Dailyja?
iVision stavlja naglasak na određene karotenoide, dok Daily okuplja širi raspon vitamina i minerala. Sastavi imaju različit fokus i nisu automatski zamjenjivi.
fact: Karotenoidi u formuli
U opisu formule istaknuti su lutein i srodni sastojci. Točne količine i ostale nutrijente provjeri na lokalnom proizvodu.

en.intro: iVision brings lutein and other selected ingredients together in one formula. Explore what distinguishes it from a general multivitamin.
en.fit: For people comparing formulas with lutein and related ingredients.
en.use: Follow the pack’s daily serving. Keep regular eye examinations as a separate part of your care.
question: How does it differ from Daily?
iVision focuses on selected carotenoids, while Daily combines a broader range of vitamins and minerals. The formulas have different focuses and are not automatically interchangeable.
fact: Carotenoids in the formula
Lutein and related ingredients are highlighted in the formula. Check amounts and other nutrients on the local product.

hr.intro: Vitamini i minerali u tabletama za žvakanje, namijenjeni djeci prema dobi navedenoj na pakiranju. Forever Kids nudi praktičan oblik koji ne zahtijeva gutanje cijele tablete.
hr.fit: Za roditelje koji uspoređuju dodatke primjerene dobi svojeg djeteta.
hr.use: Odrasla osoba odmjerava porciju prema dobi i lokalnoj uputi. Čuvaj proizvod izvan dohvata djece.
question: Mogu li sva djeca uzimati istu količinu?
Ne pretpostavljaj to. Dobna preporuka i količina nalaze se na konkretnom pakiranju; za mlađe dijete prvo pitaj pedijatra.
fact: Porcija prema dobi
Oblik za žvakanje ne znači da je proizvod namijenjen svakoj dobi. Dobna uputa dio je odabira ovog proizvoda.

en.intro: Vitamins and minerals in chewable tablets for children within the age range on the pack. Forever Kids offers a convenient format without swallowing a whole tablet.
en.fit: For parents comparing supplements appropriate for their child’s age.
en.use: An adult measures the serving according to age and local directions. Store out of children’s reach.
question: Can all children take the same amount?
Do not assume so. Age guidance and amounts are on the particular pack; ask a paediatrician first for a younger child.
fact: An age appropriate serving
A chewable format does not make it suitable for every age. Age guidance is part of choosing this product.

hr.intro: Lycium Plus kombinira goji i druge biljne sastojke. Upoznaj cijelu formulu prije odluke, posebno ako već koristiš druge biljne dodatke.
hr.fit: Za osobe koje traže koncentriranu biljnu formulu s gojijem.
hr.use: Provjeri sastojke, preporučenu porciju i upozorenja na lokalnoj deklaraciji. Ako uzimaš terapiju, provjeri prikladnost kombinacije.
question: Je li isto kao jesti goji bobice?
Ne. Tableta ima određenu formulu i porciju te može sadržavati dodatne biljne sastojke. Nije zamjena za voće u prehrani.
fact: Goji i biljna kombinacija
Opis formule navodi goji i sladić. To je koncentrirani dodatak, a ne pakiranje sušenog voća.

en.intro: Lycium Plus combines goji with other botanical ingredients. Explore the full formula, especially if you already use other botanical supplements.
en.fit: For people looking for a concentrated botanical formula containing goji.
en.use: Check ingredients, serving and warnings on the local label. If you take medication, check whether the combination is suitable.
question: Is it the same as eating goji berries?
No. A tablet has a defined formula and serving and may include other botanicals. It does not replace fruit in your diet.
fact: Goji and a botanical blend
The formula description lists goji and liquorice. It is a concentrated supplement rather than a pack of dried fruit.
